```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

## Results Overview

Below are the statewide vote totals for candidates in the 2026 Democratic primary election for Governor, aggregated across Florida's 67 counties.

```{r}
#| label: plot-democratic-governor-primary

# Locate all county result files
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read tab-delimited files and filter for the Democratic gubernatorial primary
dem_gov_results <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = c(
    "county_code", "county_name", "election_id", "election_date",
    "election_name", "precinct_id", "precinct_name", "total_registered",
    "ballots_cast", "blank1", "blank2", "contest", "district",
    "contest_code", "candidate", "party", "party_num", "doe_id", "votes"
  ),
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_character(),
    votes = col_double()
  )
) |>
  filter(contest == "Governor", party == "DEM") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)

vote_shares <- dem_gov_results |>
  mutate(share = total_votes / sum(total_votes)) |>
  mutate(category = if_else(share < 0.03, "Others", candidate)) |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(total_votes), .by = category) |>
  mutate(share = total_votes / sum(total_votes)) |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  mutate(
    exact_squares = share * 100,
    squares = floor(exact_squares),
    remainder = exact_squares - squares
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(remainder), desc(share)) |>
  mutate(
    squares = squares + as.integer(row_number() <= 100 - sum(squares))
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  mutate(
    legend_label = paste0(category, " - ", scales::percent(share, accuracy = 0.1))
  )

stopifnot(sum(vote_shares$squares) == 100)

waffle_tiles <- vote_shares |>
  select(category, legend_label, squares) |>
  uncount(squares) |>
  mutate(
    square = row_number(),
    x = (square - 1) %% 10 + 1,
    y = 10 - (square - 1) %/% 10,
    legend_label = factor(legend_label, levels = vote_shares$legend_label)
  )

ggplot(waffle_tiles, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = legend_label)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.94, height = 0.94, color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C", begin = 0.08, end = 0.9, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Florida Democratic Governor Primary",
    subtitle = "Statewide vote distribution | Each square represents 1% of the vote",
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State, precinct-level election results."
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "#202A36"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#596575"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#697586", hjust = 0, size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "#303846"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
```

David Jolly and Gwen Graham received the most votes statewide and won the Democratic nomination for Governor. Candidates receiving less than 3% of the vote are combined as “Others”; vote shares are rounded to the nearest whole percentage to fill the 100-square grid.
